maintainability.note: Parser and focused references separate concerns.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering and progressive disclosure; avoid a nonzero-exit assumption.

The parser accurately recovered canonical mapping metrics.

recommendations.title: Correct the wrong-locus exit-code claim
recommendations.problem: CRISPResso 2.3.4 logged the no-alignments error and produced no quantification table, but its container exit code was 0 rather than the stated 1.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill assumes the documented error route is a reliable process-status contract without testing this image version.
recommendations.fix: Require checking the error text and absence of CRISPResso_quantification_of_editing_frequency.txt; do not promise a nonzero exit code.
